5. Deviations from spec
- The capture used --test-reporter=spec (the briefing command shows plain node --test) so per-case results are readable.
- The final file was produced by a Node build script (live bytes + pin block), not by the Write tool, so the post-image is byte-exact to the live file by construction and the scratch copy differs only by two import anchors.
- T57: the budget guard own exhaustion denial ALREADY shows the charge (counted attempts), working cap and remaining closing slots (guard-dispatch-budget.mjs:228-245). Ruling 115 says no refusal prints its charge, which cannot be true of this guard. The pin is therefore GREEN (regression guard); the unmet half is refusals of OTHER guards and cannot be expressed in this file. Elephant should confirm this reading of TR-K4.
- T34: the speed-up is not expressible (no seam, no decided cache location); only the invariant (a state change recomputes) is pinned, GREEN-expected.
- T37 accepts either cure the row names (admit per dispatch, or refusal naming a re-dispatch action); the same-tool-id construction is an assumption (header A1). Side finding: that refusal also says the persisted counter was left unchanged and to repair it through the trusted host path, which is misleading for a first-call binding miss.

6. Open items (closing-allowance handover)
- Committed: nothing committed. Verified green: baseline capture ran (red-by-design set above); no DoD check is fully green.
- Remains undone: (a) fix T34: most likely cause is that apply needs the same option as the enroll helper, i.e. applyGovernanceScopeDecision(plan, { activate: true, planSha256: plan.planSha256 }); confirm by reading governance-scope.mjs around line 287 first (GS-PLAN); if a decline cannot be expressed, replace the case with the corrupt-state-file variant or report T34 as not expressible. (b) Edit pins.append.mjs.txt, run node scratch/dispatch-wip/TR-G-T/build.mjs, rerun the WSL copy capture, expect T34 green. (c) write TR-G-MANIFEST.md (target path, finalSha256 from build output, WSL command, per-pin state above). (d) node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs. (e) commit message file with the two trailers, git add -- the post-image and manifest, git commit -F ... -- those two paths. (f) checkpoint the record, then the final report.
- Uncommitted and incomplete: the tranche-2 post-image above (contains the broken T34 case; do not commit as is).
- Next briefing must say differently: budget at least 16 calls and point at this record instead of re-orienting; the scratch/dispatch-wip/TR-G-T/ files exist only on this machine (ignored); use a new task id for the continuation because this record is terminal.
